title: The federal government should ban minors under 18 from us...

topic.original: The federal government should ban minors under 18 from using AI chatbots that are explicitly marketed as companions, friends, or romantic partners. Educational AI tutors, mental health screening tools, and general-purpose assistants like ChatGPT would remain legal for minors even if some teenagers form emotional attachments to them. This ban would target products like Replika and Character.AI that advertise relationship features, following California and New York's regulatory approach but extending it nationwide through the proposed bipartisan Senate legislation.
